entries.title: Job 12:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 12:2
segments: "No doubt you [are] the people, And wisdom will die with you!

entries.title: Job 12:3
segments: But I have understanding as well as you; I [am] not inferior to you. Indeed, who does not [know] such things as these?

entries.title: Job 12:4
segments: "I am one mocked by his friends, Who called on God, and He answered him, The just and blameless [who is] ridiculed.

entries.title: Job 12:5
segments: A lamp is despised in the thought of one who is at ease; [It is] made ready for those whose feet slip.

entries.title: Job 12:6
segments: ¶The tents of robbers prosper, And those who provoke God are secure-In what God provides by His hand.

entries.title: Job 12:7
segments: "But now ask the beasts, and they will teach you; And the birds of the air, and they will tell you;

entries.title: Job 12:8
segments: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; And the fish of the sea will explain to you.

entries.title: Job 12:9
segments: Who among all these does not know That the hand of the LORD has done this,

entries.title: Job 12:10
segments: In whose hand [is] the life of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?

entries.title: Job 12:11
segments: Does not the ear test words And the mouth taste its food?

entries.title: Job 12:12
segments: ¶Wisdom [is] with aged men, And with length of days, understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:13
segments: "With Him [are] wisdom and strength, He has counsel and understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:14
segments: If He breaks [a thing] down, it cannot be rebuilt; [If] He imprisons a man, there can be no release.

entries.title: Job 12:15
segments: If He withholds the waters, they dry up; [If] He sends them out, they overwhelm the earth.

entries.title: Job 12:16
segments: With Him [are] strength and prudence. The deceived and the deceiver [are] His.

entries.title: Job 12:17
segments: He leads counselors away plundered, And makes fools of the judges.

entries.title: Job 12:18
segments: He loosens the bonds of kings, And binds their waist with a belt.

entries.title: Job 12:19
segments: He leads princes away plundered, And overthrows the mighty.

entries.title: Job 12:20
segments: He deprives the trusted ones of speech, And takes away the discernment of the elders.

entries.title: Job 12:21
segments: He pours contempt on princes, And disarms the mighty.

entries.title: Job 12:22
segments: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, And brings the shadow of death to light.

entries.title: Job 12:23
segments: He makes nations great, and destroys them; He enlarges nations, and guides them.

entries.title: Job 12:24
segments: He takes away the understanding of the chiefs of the people of the earth, And makes them wander in a pathless wilderness.

entries.title: Job 12:25
segments: They grope in the dark without light, And He makes them stagger like a drunken [man].
